svg.title: PREFLIGHT's before-takeoff checklist, run on every push
svg.desc: PREFLIGHT's checklist card, "Before takeoff · every push". PROCTOR (proctor): Checked; PHP tests (php-test): 8.3 · 8.4 · 8.5 pass; Composer audit (composer-audit): No advisories; SBOM (sbom): Validated; Pint (pint): Clean; PHPStan (phpstan): No errors; ESLint · Prettier (eslint): Clean; then Clearance: Cleared for takeoff. Each item is ticked in turn and its lamp on the annunciator panel goes green; A11Y, CONTRACT, FRESHNESS are marked coming soon. Checklist complete. Tray tables up, tests green.

g.text: CHECKLIST COMPLETE. TRAY TABLES UP, TESTS GREEN.

svg.text: INCLUDE: 9 COMPONENTS · STAGE TEST · DEPLOY · NO STAGE
